title: Coming back to the plan after a skip
description: Moving a session keeps what has been done and leaves a clear point to carry on from.

blocks.text: One busy day can mean setting up the whole program again.

quote.text: So what ever time you start running on the first day you have to run at that time every day. I have a very diverse schedule just cause I have time at 4pm today dosn't mean I will have time tomorrow . I might need to run at noon ..

blocks.text: Separate the sequence of sessions from the calendar. Allow repeats, moves and schedule changes without fake marks of completion.
Missing a date does not automatically mean the difficulty of the next workout has to change.
